content: {"like":["Love the show Kung Fu and its characters, especially Master Po and David Carradine’s performance.","Excellent quality of the transfers, with the film look preserved.","Strong scripts in Seasons 1 and 2 that hold up well.","Good continuity of the character Caine, staying true to his nature.","The show’s depth and lack of modern flashy music, giving it a timeless feel."],"dislike":["Missing the two‑minute recap teasers that appeared in the original ABC airings.","Missing the 60‑second “Next on Kung Fu” previews from Seasons 2 and 3.","Missing the original ABC bumpers that featured Caine and music.","Season 3 felt too cut‑dry and had fewer life lessons compared to earlier seasons."]}
